about: Exact-brand-name rule R10 (decision C3, 2026-10-23). A link whose REGISTERED DOMAIN's first label equals one of a brand's labels exactly (roblox.com.am -> 'roblox'; tldextract's top_domain_under_public_suffix, the app's link_domain), but whose registered domain is not in that brand's official list, is flagged: 'Uses the name <Brand> but is not <Brand>'s official website.' Exact label only: no substring and no fuzzy match (robloxfans.com, pineapple.com never fire; the substring / near-miss rule is R4 in brands_india.json). A missing official domain would be flagged, so each list must include the brand's country variants; the rule was run over the Tranco top 100k (scripts/exact_brand_scan.py) and every hit fixed or justified.

brands.source: Roblox Corporation's site roblox.com (the only domain of that name); the 2026-10-22 OpenPhish feed had roblox.et, .ly, .com.am, .com.pt, .com.bi, .com.ml pages (reports/eval_live_links.md section 10)
